steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Regretfully... I was late.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Does... does Your Majesty share the same regrets I do? That we were not able to stop them here?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Manfred...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Back then... in Kazdel, you would never speak to me so guardedly.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Back then, you'd look me straight in the eye.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Majesty, Kazdel was nothing more than a cluttered ruin and a thick stack of blueprints. In all those years, you and the general...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No, as things are now, there is no need to speak of past matters.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Majesty has returned to the general's side. Together, you shall rule the Royal Court and bring the Sarkaz victory once again, just as countless times in the past.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: For me and the rest of the men, we need only remember this.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Even so, Manfred... I really wish to meet the girl.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Majesty!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Do you think a person dreams, in death?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've dreamt of them often, the past few months.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Again and again I dream of that ship. I dream of conversations with that doctor of few smiles. I dream of standing shoulder to shoulder with that silent commander on the ship's deck. I dream of...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...I dream of sitting by her bedside every night, telling tales of the Sarkaz and this great land, lulling the girl to sleep.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is... the general aware?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: He knows all.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: However, a dream is but a dream...Isn't that so?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Majesty, your cheeks...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Ah... It's just ash.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I do not shed tears.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes... Why do I not shed tears?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Your Majesty, in the end you still allowed 'her' to go to the city walls?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You are aware of the threat the 'King of Sarkaz' bears.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Of course. Not even Manfred or the Sanguinarch may be capable of successfully capturing the successor to that power.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: ——To defeat a 'Sarkaz King', the safest choice is naturally another one.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Did you not intend that when you raised that suggestion to me?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I also remember that you nearly killed me when I first suggested to bring 'her' back.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: 'Vomit inducing'—— That's what you said. It's difficult to forget such fury.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: My opinion has not changed.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: But we still need 'her', do we not?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Only when the two of you stand together, will the soldiers truly believe that the chaotic and dark era of the past is now history.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: They will never again question the legitimacy of your orders. There will no longer be two different voices in the Sarkaz's hearts.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: To this end, we must get hold of the other 'Sarkaz King' as soon as possible.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then go and make sure of that.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The soldiers must focus on the war ahead.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: They must clearly understand that they are following a ruler who can lead them out of their plight, and not just some power of dubious ownership.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I know, I know. You have never cared for that black crown.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: For your satisfaction, I have never stopped researching the 'Sarkaz King' either.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Thanks to 'her', I've made great progress. Should we get our hands on that Cautus too... Perhaps, we will be able to truly understand the power of the 'Sarkaz King' before too long.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The Sarkaz are not slaves to any man or power.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: If the crown of the 'Sarkaz King' is but another shackle...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then, crush it.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Your wish aligns with my own... It will be done, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I did not expect you to return so late, Your Highness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...Keh.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You seem... tired.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Confessarius, you neglected to inform me that the banshee was there too.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Ah... I thought you'd have guessed it.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: A banshee can be more trouble to deal with than a nachzehrer. What frightening talent.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: That said, next time I'll simply stick his tongue in a crystal case and gift it to his mother.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The Regent and the Nachzehrer King will not be pleased, Your Highness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Then they'd best not find out.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Also, that Manfred... How dare he use those toys mounted on the city walls on me?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Half the filth on me is thanks to him. Perhaps I should teach him a lesson.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I understand your frustrations, Your Highness.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Consider this, as a tiny compensation for the missing intel, I will suggest the Regent grant you the task of capturing the 'Sarkaz King'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Heh, that bastard failed after all. I've been telling Theresis all this time he's just a soft-hearted coward.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It's fine, all of this is within the Regent's plans.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Let them celebrate for now. After all, the best way to crush hope is to first let it come to fruition.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hah... The nobles in the city grow restless once more. You're right, let them continue with their folly.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: When the banquet is at its peak, the abrupt shifting of laughter to horror... it's tantalizing.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Incidentally, speaking of the nobles——

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Is there anything Your Highness wishes to report to the Regent?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No, nothing.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Tell Theresis... I await the next banquet.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: He's obviously discovered something, but he's hiding it?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: These little moves... I fear the Regent will not tolerate him much longer.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Leader.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Any movement from the Duke's forces outside the city?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The Nachzehrer King will be returning soon. Once he arrives, send him to meet the Regent immediately.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Also... didn't you mention a Victorian noble sent some Messengers back?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Let us go and meet them.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Sir, there's one more thing.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Is there?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: She... actually chose to return, at such a time.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Do you have a plan, sir?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Send a message to the Royal Academy of Sciences.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It's time... for a long awaited family reunion.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz... How are you feeling? Are we going too fast? Are you tired?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You have to tell me if you feel any discomfort.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Yes... my chest feels a bit stuffy.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Is it because you're getting closer to home?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: No, that isn't my home.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Shining... My home is with you and Nearl.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I didn't want you to come back here.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: But I wanted to.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I want to go with you, and... I want to find what I've lost.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I... I can feel that they're here.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes, Nightingale. We'll find them, and they'll help you get better. You are going to get better.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: And then... we'll return to Rhodes Island. Or we could also go to Kazimierz... We'll go wherever you want.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You'll... go with me, right?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Of course, Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: No matter when, as long as you want it... I will stay by your side.

a.text: It feels like going on a brand new journey, while also returning to the starting point.
Its high walls give Londinium the feeling of a giant cage, or even a sealed graveyard. But it is also the past and present home of countless people.
This place hides many answers, yet it also leads to a great deal more questions.
To a reunion... or a separation?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Are we... alive?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes, it looks like we can finally take a breather.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: *Sniffles*... Waaah!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, w-why are you crying? I-I-I've never seen you cry before!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It's nothing, I just... I thought of Bill. When I think of him, I just...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Old Bill... *sigh*.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: *Sniffles*...*cough* N-No. I shouldn't do this.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The battle... isn't over.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's fine, Rockrock. We're safe right now. We can take a break, and think of Old Bill and our other friends...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Before the next battle starts. It's what we ought to do.
We meet at last.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You are...?
Allerdale Cumberland. Call me Allerdale.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm Clovisia's friend, and the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps' officer-in-charge of Auchterigg borough——that is, Central Londinium.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Cumberland?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're the Duke of Cumberland's...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...Daughter.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I was just a small child when Father passed away.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I only remember him brushing his sweat-laden beard on my face whenever he returned from a fencing match——This is the only memory I have left after twenty years.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I heard that the Duke of Cumberland... was betrayed by other anti-royalist dukes.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Father walked the path he believed in, for the sake of his ideals.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I respect him greatly, which is why I'm here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You and the other nobles within the city... You've been fighting against the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Yes, but our efforts have only just begun to bear fruit.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I was extremely surprised when Isabelle came to look for me.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Not just because she's the Count of Manchester's successor——Although the count has always been one of our most steadfast supporters.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's just that I thought all the Knights of the Tower were dead...Isabelle's return was a great inspiration to many of us.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Of course, what surprised me the most was... you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You know who I am?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Haha, I was not aware at first. How could I be 'surprised' otherwise?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: All these years, we have never stopped looking for you, but there were never any clues. Many thought that you were long dead...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I never believed so.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I do believe many of those looking for me actually wanted to take my life.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Perhaps so...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But even among those, there are many who've changed their minds.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You've seen what's happened to Londinium——

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: People lost their freedom long ago.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: All Victorians, even those nobles holding tightly onto their titles, must either become a slave to the Sarkaz, or tremble in fear as they hope to survive till the next day.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Even deep in slumber, they instinctively cry out 'Your Majesty'——

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Is there anyone who has not wondered, should that sudden execution all those years ago have gone another way, would Londinium be as it is today?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you really think that my presence here would change anything?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: At the very least, it opens up a new possibility.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Even though you appear to be contemplating, I know you have already set your heart on it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You sent Isabelle to contact me. Is that not a sign that you're prepared to lead us against the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't deny that I've made a decision.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But being prepared... you can never be fully prepared.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You're not wrong.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We should begin, Lady Cumberland... Allerdale. Please walk me through our current situation again.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm sure you understand that I have a lot to catch up on.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Great, I love your enthusiasm. That's just what we need right now.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Welcome home, Alexandrina... Your Majesty.
Heidi.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Kal'tsit... *Huff*, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: ——It's tough to get a meeting with you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did anyone follow you?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Don't worry, I've carefully covered my tracks all the way here.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: How could I be your Messenger if I wasn't even capable of that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've already done very well. Your father would be proud.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Frankly, many times in the past when I was close to failure... I would think of you, and wonder what you would do.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I would also think about what you would say, if I could get everyone to make it through with me...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But, now that you're really standing before me, I suddenly feel that all those things I've imagined mean nothing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Heidi, you are well prepared.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: At least... I will always be prepared. All of us will.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: By the way, are you in a hurry to see Amiya?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've confirmed that she is currently safe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's been a long time since I was in Londinium, so I have a number of matters I need to take care of.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: That's good.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: There's someone... She's been waiting to meet you.
Kal'tsit, start talking. I need an explanation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ——You're alive.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And what exactly do you wish me to explain, W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're as calm as ever. Hard for me to tell if you knew before you got here or not.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whatever, it doesn't even matter if you're a monster or not. I've got bigger fins to fry.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's Theresa... it really was Theresa!

steps.name: W
steps.text: You——How could you let Theresis get his hands on her body?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... Sorry, Doctor. I didn't see you coming.

options: You've been preoccupied ever since the train.
What did you see on the train?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I guess there's no hiding it... And I shouldn't hide it from you anyway.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I saw...her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Miss Rockrock really was talking about her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Four years ago, Theresa passed away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though Dr. Kal'tsit and W may disagree with me about the truth behind this... There's one thing we definitely wouldn't get wrong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That day, we really lost her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I don’t know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... the moment I saw her at the train station, I finally understood... why I felt those emotions in Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides anger... sorrow. An endlessly infinite sorrow.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... to the Sarkaz, anger and sorrow are symbiotic. It's just that they choose to dry their tears with anger most of the time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And all of those emotions seemed to converge in her eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even Theresa had never...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hurting? Maybe, but compared to them... those Sarkaz shattered by hate and prejudice, this is nothing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can feel it... It's too little, far too little...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I glimpsed it for a moment, but I was nearly drowned under that turbulent wave of emotion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What did Theresa go through?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is it really not?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I said before that I really couldn't believe it was her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... when I saw her with my own two eyes, I found it wasn't very difficult at all to accept.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Since I'm here, I need to know the truth.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not just the truth behind Theresa, but also the Sarkaz within the city... What exactly did they experience, that they would be burdened with such anger and sorrow?

options: And if the truth brings about more pain?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

options: But we will walk onwards together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, together...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's look for the answer.

options: This is also an answer I need.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I apologize for interrupting you——

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: There's an urgent matter concerning Alexandrina... I mean Vina, as well as our Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Based on a letter from Lady Heidi, we've confirmed that this matter relates to you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}——

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Is Edward Artorius's relic in your possession?
